Set up & run

Cost and time

What the loop reports while it works, how to read it, and which numbers are measured and which are not.

On this page
  • The three status blocks
  • Cost
  • Time

You do not need to watch a terminal. The loop prints a short status block when something changes, and one line at the end of each phase saying what happened and what it cost. Ask /sigma-status for backlog counts, /sigma-log for what is happening right now, and /sigma-time for how long things took. If a number is not shown, the line says so.

The three status blocks

BlockWhenShape
Statuswork is dispatched, or slot state changes, or nothing is left in flightTwo lines per goal in flight: a marker, the goal link, the phase, the title and the model tier; then what is happening now and what unblocks next. Up to six goals.
Eventa phase boundary is crossed, a background task finishes, a merge landsOne short paragraph: the goal, the phase it left, the phase it enters, one fact (a link, or the phase cost), and what happens next.
Decisiononly when a person is neededA blocked goal, the tradeoff in one line, at most three options and a recommendation.

Silence is valid. Reading files and finishing tool calls print nothing.

Reading a goal line

* 🔵 **[#123](url)** · P5 IMPLEMENT · Add input validation · model opus (predicted; agent-set)
  ↳ writing the change → verify → PR

**[#123](url) Add input validation** P5 IMPLEMENT → P6 REVIEW — PR [#124](url),
verify green, cost $0.31 (48,203 tokens, example-model). Reviewing it next.

The marker says is it moving. The phase token says where in the flow: P1 Goal, P2 Research, P3 Plan, P4 Plan-Review, P5 Implement, P6 Review, P7 Retro.

MarkerMeaning
⚪ queuedclaimed, not started
🔵 runningactively working
🟣 reviewwritten; review or verification in flight
🟢 mergingapproved; merge handler or CI in flight
✅ donemerged and recorded
🔴 blockedfailed, or needs a human decision
⏸️ parkeddeliberately deferred, with a reason
⏳ waitingblocked on another slot, not on a person

The model tier on a status line is predicted (what the phase intends to run on) and agent-set (an agent wrote it; no code derived it). It is a ceiling, not an observation. When none was set the line says model tier unrecorded.

Cost

  • At the end of each phase the loop prints a cost line: dollars, tokens and the model observed in that phase's own transcript. If the host cannot report it, the line says why instead of showing a number.
  • No cost line means the phase-boundary commands did not run, or the host hid their output. /sigma-log shows from the action log which phases were recorded.
  • The token budget counts only phases with a full price. When a model is missing from the rate card, every phase end warns that its turns were not counted, and /sigma-doctor reports the gap.
  • The Codex token figure is measured per phase and is an admission stop, not a bill. A cached-token total alone is not a quota or a bill either.

Time

QuestionAskNotes
Where is it right now?/sigma-logEvery active goal with its latest action and how long ago. A goal quiet for hours is a smell for you to judge; the tool claims nothing about liveness. Needs action_log.enabled.
How long did a goal, unit or session take?/sigma-timeReads a local store that no config key gates, so it exists on a stock install. A session reads precise when every turn was timed, or floor only on a host with no turn hooks; a floor-only total reads "not measurable" and must not be quoted as the total.
How long will this take?/sigma-velocityAn estimate from measured commit and pull-request throughput, not from a feeling.
How many goals are waiting?/sigma-statusPending, in progress, done, parked and failed, and whether the review queue needs you.

Never state a duration from memory or from timestamps in a conversation. Ask the store.

Technical detail

Block shapes are constructed by the status renderer from facts, not written by hand, and a malformed block is refused rather than patched.
